resources.string: Log out-of-pocket expenses in seconds or pool cash into a shared Group Pocket
Forget manual currency calculations and messy notes. Organise expenses for households, couples, friends, or trips across any currency with automatic conversion.
Log an expense in 3 quick steps using smart defaults. Customise splits (equal, exact, percentage, or family subunits), extras, and receipts only when you need them.
Pay with Your Money out of pocket like any splitter, or pool funds into a shared Group Pocket to track ATM cash withdrawals and multi-currency fees.
Stay up to date on shared expenses, consensus debts, and settlement confirmations in real time.
Check Your Position at any moment to see who owes whom and your pocket share. Settle debts with mutual confirmation so everyone agrees.
Your friends have already added you to groups and logged expenses under %1$s. Tap below to retrieve all your data.
